method: Every trial retains original provenance. Prefixes are diagnostic only. Selection requires completed routes, both-tier observed pace/wait, cohort deadlines, competent attack rate and three-seed army-line rule. High has only one officer with10 qualified samples; no full high-roster pace qualification claimed.

rows.configuration: Nearest assignment plus existing follower response only when calm. Successful prototype; cleaned implementation selected.

checks.target: every ratio ≥0.95; ≥10 walking samples/follower

≥3 admitted cohort members; real player windup within20 s
